# Synthetic test faces — NOT real people

These eight 512x512 images were generated by **StyleGAN2** (the images served by *thispersondoesnotexist.com*),
taken from the Hugging Face dataset `javi22/this-person-does-not-exist-10k` (files `face (1).jpg` … `face (8).jpg`),
then resized. They show people who do not exist and are used only so the face pipeline can be tested
automatically without a webcam and without any real person's biometric data.

`tests/synth.py` turns one face into a fake webcam burst (blinks, head turns, a static "photo attack").
